package billing_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go"
	tcpostgres "github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go/modules/postgres"
	"github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go/wait"

	"github.com/mosamlife/wpmgr/apps/api/internal/billing"
	billingrazorpay "github.com/mosamlife/wpmgr/apps/api/internal/billing/razorpay"
	"github.com/mosamlife/wpmgr/apps/api/internal/db"
	"github.com/mosamlife/wpmgr/apps/api/internal/domain"
)

func TestPaystableRouteRecoversAfterPostgresFailures(t *testing.T) {
	app, admin := paystablePostgres(t)
	tenant := uuid.New()
	if _, err := app.Exec(context.Background(), `INSERT INTO tenants (id, name, slug, billing_provider, provider_customer_id) VALUES ($1, 'Paystable', 'paystable-route-retry', 'razorpay', 'cust_paystable')`, tenant); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("could not create the test tenant: %v", err)
	}

	var fetches atomic.Int32
	providerAPI := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		fetches.Add(1)
		if r.Method != http.MethodGet || r.URL.Path != "/subscriptions/sub_paystable" {
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		fmt.Fprint(w, `{"id":"sub_paystable","plan_id":"plan_starter_usd","customer_id":"cust_paystable","status":"active","current_end":1900000000}`)
	}))
	defer providerAPI.Close()

	const secret = "paystable_webhook_secret"
	provider := billingrazorpay.New(billingrazorpay.Config{
		KeyID: "rzp_test_key", KeySecret: "rzp_test_secret", WebhookSecret: secret,
		PlanStarterUSD: "plan_starter_usd", PlanStarterINR: "plan_starter_inr",
		PlanAgencyUSD: "plan_agency_usd", PlanAgencyINR: "plan_agency_inr",
		PlanScaleUSD: "plan_scale_usd", PlanScaleINR: "plan_scale_inr",
		BaseURL: providerAPI.URL,
	})
	var logs bytes.Buffer
	logger := slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(&logs, nil))
	service := billing.New(app, nil, true, domain.SystemClock{}, logger)
	service.SetProviders(billing.NewRegistry(provider), "razorpay")
	gin.SetMode(gin.TestMode)
	router := gin.New()
	billing.NewWebhookHandler(service, logger).RegisterPublic(router)

	body := []byte(fmt.Sprintf(`{"entity":"event","event":"subscription.charged","contains":["subscription"],"payload":{"subscription":{"entity":{"id":"sub_paystable","plan_id":"plan_starter_usd","customer_id":"cust_paystable","status":"active","current_end":1900000000,"notes":{"wpmgr_tenant_id":%q}}}},"created_at":1700000000}`, tenant))
	headers := http.Header{}
	headers.Set("X-Razorpay-Signature", paystableSign(body, secret))
	headers.Set("X-Razorpay-Event-Id", "evt_paystable_route_retry")
	send := func() *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/webhooks/billing/razorpay", bytes.NewReader(body))
		request.Header = headers.Clone()
		requestContext, cancel := context.WithTimeout(request.Context(), time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		request = request.WithContext(requestContext)
		router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
		return response
	}

	if _, err := admin.Exec(context.Background(), "REVOKE INSERT ON TABLE billing_events FROM wpmgr_app"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("could not inject the PostgreSQL write failure: %v", err)
	}
	if response := send(); response.Code != http.StatusInternalServerError {
		t.Fatalf("the failed ledger write returned %d, want 500: %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	if plan, status := paystableTenantState(t, app, tenant); plan != string(billing.TierFree) || status != "none" {
		t.Fatalf("the failed request changed the tenant to %s/%s", plan, status)
	}
	if fetches.Load() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("the failed ledger write reached the provider API")
	}

	if _, err := admin.Exec(context.Background(), "GRANT INSERT ON TABLE billing_events TO wpmgr_app"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("could not restore the PostgreSQL write permission: %v", err)
	}
	if got := paystableEventCount(t, admin); got != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("the failed request left %d ledger rows, want 0", got)
	}
	if response := send(); response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("the replay returned %d, want 200: %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	if plan, status := paystableTenantState(t, app, tenant); plan != string(billing.TierStarter) || status != "active" {
		t.Fatalf("the replay left the tenant at %s/%s, want starter/active", plan, status)
	}
	if response := send(); response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("the duplicate returned %d, want 200: %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	if got := paystableEventCount(t, admin); got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("the replay and duplicate left %d ledger rows, want 1", got)
	}
	if fetches.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("the replay and duplicate made %d provider requests, want 1", fetches.Load())
	}
	if _, err := app.Exec(context.Background(), "UPDATE tenants SET plan = 'free', plan_status = 'none' WHERE id = $1", tenant); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("could not reset the tenant before the connection loss: %v", err)
	}

	headers.Set("X-Razorpay-Event-Id", "evt_paystable_connection_loss")
	var terminated int
	if err := admin.QueryRow(context.Background(), `SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) AS stopped FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE usename = 'wpmgr_app') AS connections WHERE stopped`).Scan(&terminated); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("could not terminate the PostgreSQL connections: %v", err)
	}
	if terminated == 0 {
		t.Fatal("PostgreSQL did not terminate an application connection")
	}
	if response := send(); response.Code != http.StatusInternalServerError {
		t.Fatalf("the connection loss returned %d, want 500: %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	if fetches.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("the connection loss reached the provider API")
	}
	if response := send(); response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("the replay did not recover: status %d: %s\n%s", response.Code, response.Body.String(), logs.String())
	}
	if plan, status := paystableTenantState(t, app, tenant); plan != string(billing.TierStarter) || status != "active" {
		t.Fatalf("the replay after connection loss left the tenant at %s/%s, want starter/active", plan, status)
	}
	if got := paystableEventCount(t, admin); got != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("the connection loss and replay left %d ledger rows, want 2 total", got)
	}
	if fetches.Load() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("the replay after connection loss made %d provider requests, want 2 total", fetches.Load())
	}
}

func paystablePostgres(t *testing.T) (*db.Pool, *db.Pool) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	container, err := tcpostgres.Run(ctx, "postgres:16-alpine",
		tcpostgres.WithDatabase("wpmgr"), tcpostgres.WithUsername("wpmgr"), tcpostgres.WithPassword("wpmgr"),
		testcontainers.WithWaitStrategy(wait.ForLog("database system is ready to accept connections").WithOccurrence(2).WithStartupTimeout(time.Minute)))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("could not start PostgreSQL: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = container.Terminate(ctx) })
	dsn, err := container.ConnectionString(ctx, "sslmode=disable")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("could not get the PostgreSQL connection string: %v", err)
	}
	admin, err := db.Connect(ctx, dsn)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("could not connect to PostgreSQL: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(admin.Close)
	if err := admin.Migrate(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("could not apply the database migrations: %v", err)
	}
	for _, statement := range []string{
		"ALTER ROLE wpmgr_app LOGIN PASSWORD 'app'",
		"GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO wpmgr_app",
		"GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO wpmgr_app",
		"REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON audit_log FROM wpmgr_app",
	} {
		if _, err := admin.Exec(ctx, statement); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("could not prepare the application role: %v", err)
		}
	}
	app, err := db.Connect(ctx, strings.Replace(dsn, "wpmgr:wpmgr@", "wpmgr_app:app@", 1))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("could not connect as the application role: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(app.Close)
	return app, admin
}

func paystableSign(body []byte, secret string) string {
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
	mac.Write(body)
	return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
}

func paystableTenantState(t *testing.T, pool *db.Pool, tenant uuid.UUID) (string, string) {
	t.Helper()
	var plan, status string
	if err := pool.QueryRow(context.Background(), "SELECT plan, plan_status FROM tenants WHERE id = $1", tenant).Scan(&plan, &status); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("could not read the tenant state: %v", err)
	}
	return plan, status
}

func paystableEventCount(t *testing.T, pool *db.Pool) int {
	t.Helper()
	var count int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(context.Background(), "SELECT count(*) FROM billing_events WHERE provider = 'razorpay'").Scan(&count); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("could not read the event ledger: %v", err)
	}
	return count
}
